# Publications & Scholarly Contributions

My scholarship spans **artificial intelligence, data science, health analytics, education, machine learning, and advanced quantitative methods**.

This page highlights selected peer-reviewed publications, scholarly contributions, conference proceedings, and other research outputs.

For the most current record of my scholarly work, visit my external research profiles.

## Research in Progress

My current research portfolio includes several active and emerging projects across my four research streams.

### Artificial Intelligence

- AI literacy, readiness, and student attitudes toward artificial intelligence
- Personality traits and attitudes toward artificial intelligence
- Human--AI decision-making
- Retrieval-augmented generation for large language models
- Agentic AI and the future of research

### Health & Wellness Analytics

- Sleep and metabolic health
- Physical activity, sleep, and psychological wellness
- Complementary health approaches and health behaviors
- Bayesian modeling for health and epidemiological decision-making

### Research Synthesis & Methods

- Reproducible bibliometric research workflows
- Meta-analysis and evidence synthesis
- Advanced quantitative methodology
- Open and reproducible research practices

## Open & Reproducible Scholarship

As my research program develops, I am working toward making more research outputs openly accessible and reproducible.

Where appropriate, future publications and projects will connect to:

- GitHub repositories
- Open Science Framework projects
- Pre-registrations
- Research protocols
- Reproducible analytical code
- Open datasets
- Preprints
- Supplementary materials

This approach supports the broader research philosophy of the [INSIGHT Lab](lab.qmd): creating scholarship that is rigorous, transparent, reproducible, and capable of being extended by others.
